Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you interpret excavated caves, inscriptions and monastic space.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Hillside overview and movement plan
  • Accessible Udayagiri caves
  • Selected Khandagiri viewing areas
  • Epigraphy and conservation recap

How the time is spent

  1. Hillside overview and movement plan 30 min

  2. Accessible Udayagiri caves 40 min

  3. Selected Khandagiri viewing areas 50 min

  4. Epigraphy and conservation recap 40 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe how the excavated caves are arranged across the Udayagiri and Khandagiri hillsides.
  • Interpret the accessible caves as monastic spaces of Jain heritage.
  • Explain what inscriptions and conservation work tell us about the caves.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
